provenance.asset_description: A screenshot of the Pathfinder Store Pathfinder Categories Page. The page features a banner image with the pathfinder logo on the left over a red textured background and an image of a red dragon on the right. The main part of the page is taken up by thumbnails each with a different sub category of the pathfinder store. left to right, Coming Soon, New to roleplaying, rulebooks, adventures, lost omens campaign setting, fiction and comics, pathfinder society, pathfinder first edition, and pathfinder partners.
